# FG-REVIEW-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_merge_request_that_is_not_ready_is_refused_with_its_reasons` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージリクエストはまだマージできません。止めている理由を確認してください。
- en: This merge request cannot be merged yet. Check what is blocking it.
- id: Merge request ini belum dapat digabungkan. Periksa apa yang memblokirnya.

## 原因 (cause)

evaluate_merge() (ADR-0024 §7) returned at least one blocking reason, at the merge request (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/merge`, nothing written) or again inside the merge job under the lock (the attempt was set to `superseded`, no ref moved). The reasons M3 R4 knows: not_open, draft, merge_in_progress, source_branch_missing, mergeability_unknown (the stored check is not a decision for the live head and target tip; a new check was requested), conflict (the stored check found a conflict), ff_not_possible (fast_forward and the target is not an ancestor of the head). Approvals, CODEOWNERS, required checks and discussions join with R5 / R6.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reasons` (the names, in the fixed order of ADR-0024 §7), `merge_request_id`, `head_sha` and, inside the job, `merge_id`. The HTTP answer's request_id finds the line. `gstn mr view` / `gstn mr mergeability` show the state, draft flag and the check.

## 対処 (fix)

Remove the first reason: mark the merge request ready, wait for the mergeability check (a request with mergeability_unknown queued one), resolve the conflict, or choose the merge_commit / squash method; then merge again.
